title: Stock behind each shipment
prompt: Dispatchers want to see, for each shipment, how much of the item its warehouse has on hand and reserved. Write `solve(shipments, inventory)` so it returns `shipment_id`, `warehouse_id`, `sku`, `quantity`, `on_hand` and `reserved`.
rules: Inventory has one row per warehouse and SKU. A shipment draws on the row with the same `warehouse_id` and the same `sku`.
Every shipment appears exactly once. If its warehouse has no inventory row for the SKU, `on_hand` and `reserved` are missing.
Return only these six columns, in this order.
hints: The same SKU is stocked in several warehouses, so `sku` alone matches too many rows.
Pass both columns to `on` as a list: `on=["warehouse_id", "sku"]`.
Which join type keeps a shipment that has no matching inventory row?
